core_obligations: Lift the idempotents coming from the closed fibre using the henselian property (proof lines 2302-2320).
Split the finite algebra into a finite product of pieces accordingly (proof lines 2320-2335).
Verify that each piece is finite over the pair with finite closed fibre (proof lines 2335-2344).
proof_roadmap: Split the algebra into pieces (proof lines 2320-2335).
Check that finiteness is inherited (proof lines 2335-2344).
difficulty_reason: The lemma is the finite companion of the preceding preparatory statements: for a finite algebra over a henselian pair whose closed fibre is finite over the residue field, it produces a decomposition and verifies the properties that the following statements of the section require. The proof is a 43-line argument which uses the lifting of idempotents to split the algebra and then checks that the pieces are again finite over the pair with finite closed fibre. The decomposition and the verification are both written out.
